+/** A non-2xx answer from the Worker. [isRuleViolation]: refused for a business rule (do-not-knock, geofence, consent). */
+class ApiError(val status: Int, val code: String, serverMessage: String?, val conflictId: String?) :
+    Exception(serverMessage ?: code.replace('_', ' ')) {
+    val isRuleViolation: Boolean get() = status in setOf(403, 409, 422)
+}
+
+@OptIn(ExperimentalSerializationApi::class)
+val AppJson = Json {
+    namingStrategy = JsonNamingStrategy.SnakeCase
+    ignoreUnknownKeys = true
+    explicitNulls = false
+    coerceInputValues = true
+}
+
+/** Request bodies are built as plain maps, like the iOS client. */
+fun Any?.toJson(): JsonElement = when (this) {
+    null -> JsonNull
+    is JsonElement -> this
+    is String -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Number -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Boolean -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Map<*, *> -> JsonObject(entries.associate { (k, v) -> k.toString() to v.toJson() })
+    is Iterable<*> -> JsonArray(map { it.toJson() })
+    else -> JsonPrimitive(toString())
+}
+
+/** Thin JSON client for the Worker API. Refreshes the access token once on 401. */
+object Api {
+    val base: String = BuildConfig.API_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/')
+
+    @PublishedApi internal val http = OkHttpClient.Builder()
+        .connectTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
+        .readTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
+        .build()
+
+    private val jsonType = "application/json".toMediaType()
+    private val _sessionExpired = MutableSharedFlow<Unit>(extraBufferCapacity = 1)
+    val sessionExpired: SharedFlow<Unit> = _sessionExpired
+
+    suspend inline fun <reified T> get(path: String): T = AppJson.decodeFromString(data("GET", path))
+
+    suspend inline fun <reified T> post(path: String, body: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()): T =
+        AppJson.decodeFromString(data("POST", path, body))
+
+    suspend fun send(method: String, path: String, body: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()): String = data(method, path, body)
+
+    suspend fun data(method: String, path: String, body: Map<String, Any?>? = null, retried: Boolean = false): String =
+        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            val builder = Request.Builder().url("$base/v1/$path")
+            TokenStore.tokens?.let { builder.header("Authorization", "Bearer ${it.accessToken}") }
+            val payload = if (method == "GET") null else (body ?: emptyMap()).toJson().toString().toRequestBody(jsonType)
+            builder.method(method, payload)
+
+            val (status, text) = http.newCall(builder.build()).execute().use { it.code to it.body?.string().orEmpty() }
+
+            if (status == 401 && !retried && !path.startsWith("auth/")) {
+                val refresh = TokenStore.tokens?.refreshToken
+                if (refresh != null && refreshTokens(refresh)) return@withContext data(method, path, body, retried = true)
+                if (refresh != null) {
+                    TokenStore.tokens = null
+                    _sessionExpired.tryEmit(Unit)
+                }
+            }
+            if (status !in 200..299) {
+                val obj = runCatching { AppJson.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject }.getOrNull()
+                fun field(k: String) = obj?.get(k)?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
+                throw ApiError(status, field("error") ?: "http_$status", field("message"), field("conflict_id"))
+            }
+            text
+        }
+
+    private suspend fun refreshTokens(refresh: String): Boolean =
+        runCatching { post<Tokens>("auth/refresh", mapOf("refresh_token" to refresh)) }
+            .onSuccess { TokenStore.tokens = it }
+            .isSuccess
+
+    /** Two-step private upload: get a signed URL, then PUT the bytes. Returns the storage key. */
+    suspend fun upload(bytes: ByteArray, kind: String, contentType: String = "image/jpeg"): String {
+        val ticket = post<UploadTicket>("uploads", mapOf("kind" to kind, "content_type" to contentType))
+        val ok = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            val req = Request.Builder().url(ticket.uploadUrl).put(bytes.toRequestBody(contentType.toMediaType())).build()
+            http.newCall(req).execute().use { it.code == 201 }
+        }
+        if (!ok) throw ApiError(0, "upload_failed", null, null)
+        return ticket.key
+    }
+}
+
+/** Last-known-good copies of GET responses so the field app works without LTE. */
+object OfflineCache {
+    lateinit var dir: File
+
+    suspend inline fun <reified T> get(path: String): T {
+        val file = File(dir, path.replace('/', '_') + ".json")
+        return try {
+            val text = Api.data("GET", path)
+            val value = AppJson.decodeFromString<T>(text)
+            runCatching { file.writeText(text) }
+            value
+        } catch (e: IOException) {
+            val cached = runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString<T>(file.readText()) }.getOrNull()
+            cached ?: throw e
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun clear() {
+        dir.listFiles { f -> f.extension == "json" }?.forEach { it.delete() }
+    }
+}
+
+/** Access + refresh tokens, encrypted with a key that never leaves the Android Keystore. */
+object TokenStore {
+    private const val ALIAS = "dealerdoor.tokens"
+    private lateinit var prefs: SharedPreferences
+    private var cached: Tokens? = null
+    private var loaded = false
+
+    fun init(context: Context) {
+        prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("secure", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+    }
+
+    var tokens: Tokens?
+        @Synchronized get() {
+            if (!loaded) {
+                cached = prefs.getString("tokens", null)?.let { runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString<Tokens>(decrypt(it)) }.getOrNull() }
+                loaded = true
+            }
+            return cached
+        }
+        @Synchronized set(value) {
+            cached = value
+            loaded = true
+            prefs.edit().apply {
+                if (value == null) remove("tokens") else putString("tokens", encrypt(AppJson.encodeToString(Tokens.serializer(), value)))
+            }.apply()
+        }
+
+    private fun key(): SecretKey {
+        val ks = KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore").apply { load(null) }
+        (ks.getKey(ALIAS, null) as? SecretKey)?.let { return it }
+        val gen = KeyGenerator.getInstance(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_AES, "AndroidKeyStore")
+        gen.init(
+            KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(ALIAS, KeyProperties.PURPOSE_ENCRYPT or KeyProperties.PURPOSE_DECRYPT)
+                .setBlockModes(KeyProperties.BLOCK_MODE_GCM)
+                .setEncryptionPaddings(KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE)
+                .build(),
+        )
+        return gen.generateKey()
+    }
+
+    private fun encrypt(plain: String): String {
+        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding").apply { init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key()) }
+        return Base64.encodeToString(cipher.iv + cipher.doFinal(plain.toByteArray()), Base64.NO_WRAP)
+    }
+
+    private fun decrypt(stored: String): String {
+        val bytes = Base64.decode(stored, Base64.NO_WRAP)
+        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding").apply { init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, key(), GCMParameterSpec(128, bytes, 0, 12)) }
+        return String(cipher.doFinal(bytes, 12, bytes.size - 12))
+    }
+}

+object Auth {
+    private val _state = MutableStateFlow<AuthState>(AuthState.Loading)
+    val state: StateFlow<AuthState> = _state
+    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main)
+
+    fun init() {
+        // Returning users unlock with fingerprint / face / screen lock instead of a new magic link.
+        _state.value = if (TokenStore.tokens == null) AuthState.SignedOut else AuthState.Locked
+        scope.launch { Api.sessionExpired.collect { _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut } }
+    }

+    fun resetForUiTest() {
+        TokenStore.tokens = null
+        OfflineCache.clear()
+        SyncEngine.clear()
+        _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut
+    }

+    /** Password login returns tokens; otherwise the server emails a link (debug builds get the token back). */
+    suspend fun login(email: String, password: String?): Boolean {
+        val body = buildMap<String, Any?> {
+            put("email", email)
+            if (!password.isNullOrEmpty()) put("password", password)
+        }
+        val res = Api.post<LoginResponse>("auth/login", body)
+        if (res.accessToken != null && res.refreshToken != null) return finish(Tokens(res.accessToken, res.refreshToken))
+        if (com.dealerdoor.app.BuildConfig.DEBUG && res.devToken != null) return verify(res.devToken)
+        return false
+    }
+
+    suspend fun verify(token: String): Boolean = finish(Api.post("auth/verify", mapOf("token" to token)))
+
+    /** Handles dealerdoor://auth?token=… from the sign-in email. */
+    fun handle(uri: Uri) {

+        scope.launch { runCatching { verify(token) } }
+    }
+
+    private suspend fun finish(tokens: Tokens): Boolean {
+        TokenStore.tokens = tokens
+        loadMe()
+        return true
+    }
+
+    suspend fun loadMe() {
+        val me = Api.get<Me>("me")

+        if (me.locale != Lang.code) runCatching { Api.send("PATCH", "me", mapOf("locale" to Lang.code)) }
+    }
+
+    fun unlocked() {
+        scope.launch { runCatching { loadMe() }.onFailure { _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut } }
+    }
+
+    fun signOut() {

+            TokenStore.tokens?.refreshToken?.let { refresh -> runCatching { Api.send("POST", "auth/logout", mapOf("refresh_token" to refresh)) } }

+object LocationTracker {

+    val location: StateFlow<Location?> = _location
+    private var started = false
+
+    fun hasPermission(context: Context) =
+        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
+
+    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
+    fun start(context: Context) {
+        if (started || !hasPermission(context)) return
+        started = true
+        val lm = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
+        val listener = LocationListener { _location.value = it }
+        for (provider in listOf(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)) {
+            if (lm.isProviderEnabled(provider)) {
+                lm.getLastKnownLocation(provider)?.let { if (_location.value == null) _location.value = it }
+                lm.requestLocationUpdates(provider, 5_000L, 5f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper())
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** Street address for the rep's current spot (on-device geocoder, no API key). */
+    suspend fun currentAddress(context: Context): String? {
+        val loc = _location.value ?: return null
+        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
+            val a = runCatching { Geocoder(context, Locale.US).getFromLocation(loc.latitude, loc.longitude, 1)?.firstOrNull() }.getOrNull()
+                ?: return@withContext null
+            listOfNotNull(
+                listOfNotNull(a.subThoroughfare, a.thoroughfare).joinToString(" ").ifBlank { null },
+                a.locality,
+                listOfNotNull(a.adminArea?.let(::stateCode), a.postalCode).joinToString(" ").ifBlank { null },
+            ).joinToString(", ")
+        }
+    }

+    private fun parse(s: String): Instant? =
+        runCatching { OffsetDateTime.parse(s).toInstant() }.getOrNull()
+            ?: runCatching { LocalDateTime.parse(s.replace(' ', 'T')).toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC) }.getOrNull()
+
+    /** Accepts ISO-8601 and SQLite "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (UTC). */
+    fun date(s: String?, time: Boolean = false): String {
+        if (s == null) return "—"
+        val instant = parse(s) ?: return s
+        val f = if (time) DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDateTime(FormatStyle.MEDIUM, FormatStyle.SHORT) else DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM)
+        return f.withLocale(Locale.getDefault()).format(instant.atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()))
+    }
+
+    /** Due dates are plain YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific time. */
+    fun day(s: String): String =

+/** A field capture (lead, check-in, appointment) waiting to reach the server. Photos live next to the queue file. */
+@Serializable
+data class PendingOp(
+    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
+    val path: String,
+    val body: String,
+    val label: String,
+    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
+    val attempts: Int = 0,
+    val lastError: String? = null,
+    /** Server refused it on a business rule (e.g. do-not-knock); kept for the rep to see, never retried. */
+    val conflicted: Boolean = false,
+    val photoFile: String? = null,
+    val photoKind: String? = null,
+    val signatureFile: String? = null,
+)
+
+/**
+ * Every capture goes through this queue, online or not, so there is one code path.
+ * Records carry a client UUID in `body["id"]`, so the API treats replays as no-ops.
+ */
+object SyncEngine {
+    private lateinit var dir: File
+    private val queueFile get() = File(dir, "queue.json")
+    private val mutex = Mutex()
+    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
+    private val _ops = MutableStateFlow<List<PendingOp>>(emptyList())
+    val ops: StateFlow<List<PendingOp>> = _ops
+
+    fun init(filesDir: File) {
+        dir = File(filesDir, "sync").apply { mkdirs() }
+        _ops.value = runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(PendingOp.serializer()), queueFile.readText()) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
+    }
+
+    fun enqueue(path: String, body: Map<String, Any?>, label: String, photo: ByteArray? = null, photoKind: String? = null, signature: ByteArray? = null) {
+        val id = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+        val photoFile = photo?.let { File(dir, "$id.jpg").apply { writeBytes(it) }.name }
+        val sigFile = signature?.let { File(dir, "$id.sig.png").apply { writeBytes(it) }.name }
+        val op = PendingOp(id = id, path = path, body = body.toJson().toString(), label = label, photoFile = photoFile, photoKind = photoKind, signatureFile = sigFile)
+        scope.launch {
+            mutex.withLock { save(_ops.value + op) }
+            flush()
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun dismiss(op: PendingOp) {
+        scope.launch { mutex.withLock { remove(op) } }
+    }
+
+    fun clear() {
+        scope.launch { mutex.withLock { _ops.value.forEach(::remove) } }
+    }
+
+    /** Replays in capture order. Network/server errors stop the run; rule violations flag that item and move on. */
+    suspend fun flush() {
+        if (TokenStore.tokens == null || !mutex.tryLock()) return
+        try {
+            for (op in _ops.value.filter { !it.conflicted }) {
+                var current = op
+                try {
+                    val body = AppJson.parseToJsonElement(current.body).jsonObject.toMutableMap()
+                    current.photoFile?.let { name ->
+                        body["photo_key"] = JsonPrimitive(Api.upload(File(dir, name).readBytes(), current.photoKind ?: "door_photo"))
+                        File(dir, name).delete()
+                        current = current.copy(photoFile = null, body = JsonObject(body).toString()).also(::replace)
+                    }
+                    current.signatureFile?.let { name ->
+                        body["signature_key"] = JsonPrimitive(Api.upload(File(dir, name).readBytes(), "signature", "image/png"))
+                        File(dir, name).delete()
+                        current = current.copy(signatureFile = null, body = JsonObject(body).toString()).also(::replace)
+                    }
+                    Api.send("POST", current.path, body)
+                    remove(current)
+                } catch (e: ApiError) {
+                    if (e.status in 400..499 && e.status != 401 && e.status != 429) {
+                        replace(current.copy(conflicted = true, lastError = e.message))
+                    } else {
+                        replace(current.copy(attempts = current.attempts + 1, lastError = e.message))
+                        return
+                    }
+                } catch (e: Exception) {
+                    replace(current.copy(attempts = current.attempts + 1, lastError = e.message))
+                    return
+                }
+            }
+        } finally {
+            mutex.unlock()
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun flushInBackground() {
+        scope.launch { flush() }
+    }
+
+    private fun replace(op: PendingOp) = save(_ops.value.map { if (it.id == op.id) op else it })
+
+    private fun remove(op: PendingOp) {
+        listOfNotNull(op.photoFile, op.signatureFile).forEach { File(dir, it).delete() }
+        save(_ops.value.filterNot { it.id == op.id })
+    }
+
+    private fun save(list: List<PendingOp>) {
+        _ops.value = list
+        queueFile.writeText(AppJson.encodeToString(ListSerializer(PendingOp.serializer()), list))
+    }
+}

+@Composable

+    var value by remember(key) { mutableStateOf<T?>(null) }

+    val reload: suspend () -> Unit = {
+        try {

+/** Finger signature, exported as PNG for the consent record. */
+@Composable
+fun SignaturePad(onChange: (ByteArray?) -> Unit) {
+    val lines = remember { mutableStateListOf<List<Offset>>() }
+    var current by remember { mutableStateOf<List<Offset>>(emptyList()) }
+    val ink = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
+    val label = stringResource(R.string.signature_area)
+
+    fun export(widthPx: Int, heightPx: Int) {
+        if (lines.isEmpty()) return onChange(null)
+        val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(widthPx, heightPx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
+        val c = AndroidCanvas(bmp).apply { drawColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE) }
+        val paint = Paint().apply { color = android.graphics.Color.BLACK; strokeWidth = 5f; style = Paint.Style.STROKE; isAntiAlias = true; strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND }
+        for (line in lines) for (i in 1 until line.size) c.drawLine(line[i - 1].x, line[i - 1].y, line[i].x, line[i].y, paint)
+        onChange(ByteArrayOutputStream().also { bmp.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, it) }.toByteArray())
+    }
+
+    Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp)) {
+        Canvas(
+            Modifier
+                .fillMaxWidth()
+                .height(140.dp)
+                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
+                .semantics { contentDescription = label }
+                .pointerInput(Unit) {
+                    detectDragGestures(
+                        onDragStart = { current = listOf(it) },
+                        onDrag = { change, _ -> current = current + change.position },
+                        onDragEnd = {
+                            lines.add(current)
+                            current = emptyList()
+                            export(this.size.width, this.size.height)
+                        },
+                    )
+                },
+        ) {
+            for (line in lines + listOf(current)) {
+                if (line.size < 2) continue
+                val path = Path().apply { moveTo(line[0].x, line[0].y); line.drop(1).forEach { lineTo(it.x, it.y) } }
+                drawPath(path, ink, style = Stroke(width = 5f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
+            }
+        }
+        TextButton(onClick = { lines.clear(); onChange(null) }, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.End)) { Text(stringResource(R.string.clear)) }
+    }

+/**
+ * Taps through the main screens against the local Worker (seed/dev.sql + e2e/tests/01-app-contract.spec.ts)
+ * and saves a screenshot of each one. CI copies them off the emulator so every PR shows what the app looks like.
+ */
+@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
+class SmokeTest {
+    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()
+    @get:Rule val location: GrantPermissionRule = GrantPermissionRule.grant(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION)
+
+    private lateinit var scenario: ActivityScenario<MainActivity>
+
+    @Before fun launch() {
+        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
+        scenario = ActivityScenario.launch(Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).putExtra(UiTest.EXTRA, true))
+    }
+
+    @After fun close() = scenario.close()
+
+    @Test fun loginNeedsAnEmail() {
+        waitFor(hasTestTag("login.email"))
+        snap("00-login")
+        compose.onNode(hasTestTag("login.submit")).assertIsNotEnabled()
+        compose.onNode(hasTestTag("login.email")).performTextInput("not-an-email")
+        compose.onNode(hasTestTag("login.submit")).assertIsNotEnabled()
+    }
+
+    @Test fun coworkerTour() {
+        signIn("rep1@dealerdoor.test")
+        waitFor(hasText("Demo route"), 30_000)
+        snap("01-coworker-route")
+
+        if (exists(hasText("Weekly check-in: 3 quick questions"))) {
+            tap(hasText("Weekly check-in: 3 quick questions"))
+            waitFor(hasText("How fair was your workload this week?"))
+            snap("02-coworker-pulse")
+            tap(hasText("Later"))
+        }
+
+        val door = hasText("4800 S 188th St", substring = true) and hasClickAction()
+        if (exists(door)) {
+            compose.onAllNodes(door)[0].performClick()
+            waitFor(hasText("Interested: capture lead"))
+            snap("03-coworker-door")
+            tap(hasText("Interested: capture lead"))
+            waitFor(hasText("Customer agrees to calls and texts"))
+            snap("04-coworker-lead-from-door")
+            tap(hasContentDescription("Cancel"))
+        }
+
+        tap(hasText("Leads") and hasClickAction())
+        waitFor(hasText("My leads"))
+        snap("05-coworker-leads")
+        tap(hasContentDescription("New lead"))
+        waitFor(hasText("Customer agrees to calls and texts"))
+        snap("06-coworker-new-lead")
+        tap(hasContentDescription("Cancel"))
+
+        tap(hasText("Me") and hasClickAction())
+        waitFor(hasText("My scorecard"))
+        snap("07-coworker-scorecard")
+    }
+
+    @Test fun customerTour() {
+        signIn("customer@dealerdoor.test")
+        val order = hasText("4800 S 188th St", substring = true) and hasClickAction()
+        waitFor(order, 30_000) // run `npm run seed:customer` in e2e/ first so the customer has an order
+        snap("10-customer-orders")
+        compose.onAllNodes(order)[0].performClick()
+        waitFor(hasText("Your plan"))
+        snap("11-customer-timeline")
+        tap(hasContentDescription("Back"))
+
+        tap(hasText("Invoices") and hasClickAction())
+        waitFor(hasText("Inside wiring"))
+        snap("12-customer-invoices")
+        compose.onAllNodes(hasText("Inside wiring"))[0].performClick()
+        waitFor(hasText("Pay with card"))
+        snap("13-customer-invoice-detail")
+        tap(hasContentDescription("Back"))
+
+        tap(hasText("Feedback") and hasClickAction())
+        waitFor(hasText("Feedback opens after activation"))
+        snap("14-customer-feedback")
+    }
+
+    // ---- Helpers ----
+
+    private fun signIn(email: String) {
+        waitFor(hasTestTag("login.email"))
+        compose.onNode(hasTestTag("login.email")).performTextInput(email)
+        compose.onNode(hasTestTag("login.submit")).performClick()
+    }
+
+    private fun exists(matcher: SemanticsMatcher, timeout: Long = 5_000): Boolean =
+        runCatching { waitFor(matcher, timeout); true }.getOrDefault(false)
+
+    private fun waitFor(matcher: SemanticsMatcher, timeout: Long = 15_000) {
+        compose.waitUntil(timeout) { compose.onAllNodes(matcher).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
+    }
+
+    private fun tap(matcher: SemanticsMatcher) {
+        waitFor(matcher)
+        compose.onAllNodes(matcher)[0].performClick()
+        compose.waitForIdle()
+    }
+
+    /** Full-screen capture (includes dialogs and bottom sheets), saved via the test storage service. */
+    private fun snap(name: String) {
+        compose.waitForIdle()
+        Thread.sleep(500) // let images and map tiles settle
+        val shot = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.takeScreenshot() ?: return
+        TestStorage().openOutputFile("screenshots/$name.png").use { shot.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, it) }
+    }
+}

+package com.dealerdoor.app.core
+
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.SharedPreferences

+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharedFlow

+import javax.crypto.SecretKey
+import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec
+
+/** A non-2xx answer from the Worker. [isRuleViolation]: refused for a business rule (do-not-knock, geofence, consent). */
+class ApiError(val status: Int, val code: String, serverMessage: String?, val conflictId: String?) :
+    Exception(serverMessage ?: code.replace('_', ' ')) {
+    val isRuleViolation: Boolean get() = status in setOf(403, 409, 422)
+}
+
+@OptIn(ExperimentalSerializationApi::class)
+val AppJson = Json {
+    namingStrategy = JsonNamingStrategy.SnakeCase
+    ignoreUnknownKeys = true
+    explicitNulls = false
+    coerceInputValues = true
+}
+
+/** Request bodies are built as plain maps, like the iOS client. */
+fun Any?.toJson(): JsonElement = when (this) {
+    null -> JsonNull
+    is JsonElement -> this
+    is String -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Number -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Boolean -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Map<*, *> -> JsonObject(entries.associate { (k, v) -> k.toString() to v.toJson() })
+    is Iterable<*> -> JsonArray(map { it.toJson() })
+    else -> JsonPrimitive(toString())
+}
+
+/** Thin JSON client for the Worker API. Refreshes the access token once on 401. */
+object Api {
+    val base: String = BuildConfig.API_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/')
+
+    @PublishedApi internal val http = OkHttpClient.Builder()
+        .connectTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
+        .readTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
+        .build()
+
+    private val jsonType = "application/json".toMediaType()
+    private val _sessionExpired = MutableSharedFlow<Unit>(extraBufferCapacity = 1)
+    val sessionExpired: SharedFlow<Unit> = _sessionExpired
+
+    suspend inline fun <reified T> get(path: String): T = AppJson.decodeFromString(data("GET", path))
+
+    suspend inline fun <reified T> post(path: String, body: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()): T =
+        AppJson.decodeFromString(data("POST", path, body))
+
+    suspend fun send(method: String, path: String, body: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()): String = data(method, path, body)
+
+    suspend fun data(method: String, path: String, body: Map<String, Any?>? = null, retried: Boolean = false): String =
+        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            val builder = Request.Builder().url("$base/v1/$path")
+            TokenStore.tokens?.let { builder.header("Authorization", "Bearer ${it.accessToken}") }
+            val payload = if (method == "GET") null else (body ?: emptyMap()).toJson().toString().toRequestBody(jsonType)
+            builder.method(method, payload)
+
+            val (status, text) = http.newCall(builder.build()).execute().use { it.code to it.body?.string().orEmpty() }
+
+            if (status == 401 && !retried && !path.startsWith("auth/")) {
+                val refresh = TokenStore.tokens?.refreshToken
+                if (refresh != null && refreshTokens(refresh)) return@withContext data(method, path, body, retried = true)
+                if (refresh != null) {
+                    TokenStore.tokens = null
+                    _sessionExpired.tryEmit(Unit)
+                }
+            }
+            if (status !in 200..299) {
+                val obj = runCatching { AppJson.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject }.getOrNull()
+                fun field(k: String) = obj?.get(k)?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
+                throw ApiError(status, field("error") ?: "http_$status", field("message"), field("conflict_id"))
+            }
+            text
+        }
+
+    private suspend fun refreshTokens(refresh: String): Boolean =
+        runCatching { post<Tokens>("auth/refresh", mapOf("refresh_token" to refresh)) }
+            .onSuccess { TokenStore.tokens = it }
+            .isSuccess
+
+    /** Two-step private upload: get a signed URL, then PUT the bytes. Returns the storage key. */
+    suspend fun upload(bytes: ByteArray, kind: String, contentType: String = "image/jpeg"): String {
+        val ticket = post<UploadTicket>("uploads", mapOf("kind" to kind, "content_type" to contentType))
+        val ok = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            val req = Request.Builder().url(ticket.uploadUrl).put(bytes.toRequestBody(contentType.toMediaType())).build()
+            http.newCall(req).execute().use { it.code == 201 }
+        }
+        if (!ok) throw ApiError(0, "upload_failed", null, null)
+        return ticket.key
+    }
+}
+
+/** Last-known-good copies of GET responses so the field app works without LTE. */
+object OfflineCache {
+    lateinit var dir: File
+
+    suspend inline fun <reified T> get(path: String): T {
+        val file = File(dir, path.replace('/', '_') + ".json")
+        return try {
+            val text = Api.data("GET", path)
+            val value = AppJson.decodeFromString<T>(text)
+            runCatching { file.writeText(text) }
+            value
+        } catch (e: IOException) {
+            val cached = runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString<T>(file.readText()) }.getOrNull()
+            cached ?: throw e
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun clear() {
+        dir.listFiles { f -> f.extension == "json" }?.forEach { it.delete() }
+    }
+}
+
+/** Access + refresh tokens, encrypted with a key that never leaves the Android Keystore. */
+object TokenStore {
+    private const val ALIAS = "dealerdoor.tokens"
+    private lateinit var prefs: SharedPreferences
+    private var cached: Tokens? = null
+    private var loaded = false
+
+    fun init(context: Context) {
+        prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("secure", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+    }
+
+    var tokens: Tokens?
+        @Synchronized get() {
+            if (!loaded) {
+                cached = prefs.getString("tokens", null)?.let { runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString<Tokens>(decrypt(it)) }.getOrNull() }
+                loaded = true
+            }
+            return cached
+        }
+        @Synchronized set(value) {
+            cached = value
+            loaded = true
+            prefs.edit().apply {
+                if (value == null) remove("tokens") else putString("tokens", encrypt(AppJson.encodeToString(Tokens.serializer(), value)))
+            }.apply()
+        }
+
+    private fun key(): SecretKey {
+        val ks = KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore").apply { load(null) }
+        (ks.getKey(ALIAS, null) as? SecretKey)?.let { return it }
+        val gen = KeyGenerator.getInstance(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_AES, "AndroidKeyStore")
+        gen.init(
+            KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(ALIAS, KeyProperties.PURPOSE_ENCRYPT or KeyProperties.PURPOSE_DECRYPT)
+                .setBlockModes(KeyProperties.BLOCK_MODE_GCM)
+                .setEncryptionPaddings(KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE)
+                .build(),
+        )
+        return gen.generateKey()
+    }
+
+    private fun encrypt(plain: String): String {
+        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding").apply { init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key()) }
+        return Base64.encodeToString(cipher.iv + cipher.doFinal(plain.toByteArray()), Base64.NO_WRAP)
+    }
+
+    private fun decrypt(stored: String): String {
+        val bytes = Base64.decode(stored, Base64.NO_WRAP)
+        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding").apply { init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, key(), GCMParameterSpec(128, bytes, 0, 12)) }
+        return String(cipher.doFinal(bytes, 12, bytes.size - 12))
+    }
+}

+// ---- Auth ----
+
+sealed interface AuthState {
+    data object Loading : AuthState
+    data object SignedOut : AuthState
+    data object Locked : AuthState
+    data class SignedIn(val me: Me) : AuthState
+}
+
+object Auth {
+    private val _state = MutableStateFlow<AuthState>(AuthState.Loading)
+    val state: StateFlow<AuthState> = _state
+    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main)
+
+    fun init() {
+        // Returning users unlock with fingerprint / face / screen lock instead of a new magic link.
+        _state.value = if (TokenStore.tokens == null) AuthState.SignedOut else AuthState.Locked
+        scope.launch { Api.sessionExpired.collect { _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut } }
+    }
+
+    fun resetForUiTest() {
+        TokenStore.tokens = null
+        OfflineCache.clear()
+        SyncEngine.clear()
+        _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut
+    }
+
+    /** Password login returns tokens; otherwise the server emails a link (debug builds get the token back). */
+    suspend fun login(email: String, password: String?): Boolean {
+        val body = buildMap<String, Any?> {
+            put("email", email)
+            if (!password.isNullOrEmpty()) put("password", password)
+        }
+        val res = Api.post<LoginResponse>("auth/login", body)
+        if (res.accessToken != null && res.refreshToken != null) return finish(Tokens(res.accessToken, res.refreshToken))
+        if (com.dealerdoor.app.BuildConfig.DEBUG && res.devToken != null) return verify(res.devToken)
+        return false
+    }
+
+    suspend fun verify(token: String): Boolean = finish(Api.post("auth/verify", mapOf("token" to token)))
+
+    /** Handles dealerdoor://auth?token=… from the sign-in email. */
+    fun handle(uri: Uri) {
+        val token = uri.getQueryParameter("token") ?: return
+        scope.launch { runCatching { verify(token) } }
+    }
+
+    private suspend fun finish(tokens: Tokens): Boolean {
+        TokenStore.tokens = tokens
+        loadMe()
+        return true
+    }
+
+    suspend fun loadMe() {
+        val me = Api.get<Me>("me")
+        _state.value = AuthState.SignedIn(me)
+        // Keep server-side email language in sync with the phone.
+        if (me.locale != Lang.code) runCatching { Api.send("PATCH", "me", mapOf("locale" to Lang.code)) }
+    }
+
+    fun unlocked() {
+        scope.launch { runCatching { loadMe() }.onFailure { _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut } }
+    }
+
+    fun signOut() {
+        scope.launch {
+            TokenStore.tokens?.refreshToken?.let { refresh -> runCatching { Api.send("POST", "auth/logout", mapOf("refresh_token" to refresh)) } }
+            TokenStore.tokens = null
+            OfflineCache.clear()
+            _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut
+        }
+    }
+}

+object NetworkMonitor {
+    private val _online = MutableStateFlow(true)
+    val online: StateFlow<Boolean> = _online

+    fun start(context: Context) {
+        val cm = context.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)
+        _online.value = cm.activeNetwork != null
+        cm.registerDefaultNetworkCallback(object : ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
+            override fun onAvailable(network: Network) {
+                val cameBack = !_online.value
+                _online.value = true
+                if (cameBack) SyncEngine.flushInBackground()
+            }
+
+            override fun onLost(network: Network) {
+                _online.value = false
+            }
+        })
+    }
+}
+
+object LocationTracker {
+    private val _location = MutableStateFlow<Location?>(null)
+    val location: StateFlow<Location?> = _location
+    private var started = false
+
+    fun hasPermission(context: Context) =
+        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
+
+    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
+    fun start(context: Context) {
+        if (started || !hasPermission(context)) return
+        started = true
+        val lm = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
+        val listener = LocationListener { _location.value = it }
+        for (provider in listOf(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)) {
+            if (lm.isProviderEnabled(provider)) {
+                lm.getLastKnownLocation(provider)?.let { if (_location.value == null) _location.value = it }
+                lm.requestLocationUpdates(provider, 5_000L, 5f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper())
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** Street address for the rep's current spot (on-device geocoder, no API key). */
+    suspend fun currentAddress(context: Context): String? {
+        val loc = _location.value ?: return null
+        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
+            val a = runCatching { Geocoder(context, Locale.US).getFromLocation(loc.latitude, loc.longitude, 1)?.firstOrNull() }.getOrNull()
+                ?: return@withContext null
+            listOfNotNull(
+                listOfNotNull(a.subThoroughfare, a.thoroughfare).joinToString(" ").ifBlank { null },
+                a.locality,
+                listOfNotNull(a.adminArea?.let(::stateCode), a.postalCode).joinToString(" ").ifBlank { null },
+            ).joinToString(", ")
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun stateCode(name: String) = if (name.equals("Washington", ignoreCase = true)) "WA" else name
+}
+
+// ---- Formatting & images ----
+
+object Fmt {
+    fun money(cents: Int): String = NumberFormat.getCurrencyInstance(Locale.US).format(cents / 100.0)
+
+    private fun parse(s: String): Instant? =
+        runCatching { OffsetDateTime.parse(s).toInstant() }.getOrNull()
+            ?: runCatching { LocalDateTime.parse(s.replace(' ', 'T')).toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC) }.getOrNull()
+
+    /** Accepts ISO-8601 and SQLite "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (UTC). */
+    fun date(s: String?, time: Boolean = false): String {
+        if (s == null) return "—"
+        val instant = parse(s) ?: return s
+        val f = if (time) DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDateTime(FormatStyle.MEDIUM, FormatStyle.SHORT) else DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM)
+        return f.withLocale(Locale.getDefault()).format(instant.atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()))
+    }
+
+    /** Due dates are plain YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific time. */
+    fun day(s: String): String =
+        runCatching { DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM).withLocale(Locale.getDefault()).format(LocalDate.parse(s)) }.getOrDefault(s)
+
+    fun iso(instant: Instant): String = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_INSTANT.format(instant)
+}

+object ImageTools {
+    /** Downscale to keep uploads small on LTE. */
+    fun jpeg(context: Context, uri: Uri, maxSide: Int = 1600): ByteArray? = runCatching {
+        val bitmap = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use(BitmapFactory::decodeStream) ?: return null
+        val scale = minOf(1f, maxSide.toFloat() / maxOf(bitmap.width, bitmap.height))
+        val scaled = if (scale < 1f) Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bitmap, (bitmap.width * scale).toInt(), (bitmap.height * scale).toInt(), true) else bitmap
+        ByteArrayOutputStream().also { scaled.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 70, it) }.toByteArray()
+    }.getOrNull()
+}

+package com.dealerdoor.app.core

+
+/** A field capture (lead, check-in, appointment) waiting to reach the server. Photos live next to the queue file. */
+@Serializable
+data class PendingOp(
+    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
+    val path: String,
+    val body: String,
+    val label: String,
+    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
+    val attempts: Int = 0,
+    val lastError: String? = null,
+    /** Server refused it on a business rule (e.g. do-not-knock); kept for the rep to see, never retried. */
+    val conflicted: Boolean = false,
+    val photoFile: String? = null,
+    val photoKind: String? = null,
+    val signatureFile: String? = null,
+)
+
+/**
+ * Every capture goes through this queue, online or not, so there is one code path.
+ * Records carry a client UUID in `body["id"]`, so the API treats replays as no-ops.
+ */
+object SyncEngine {
+    private lateinit var dir: File
+    private val queueFile get() = File(dir, "queue.json")
+    private val mutex = Mutex()
+    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
+    private val _ops = MutableStateFlow<List<PendingOp>>(emptyList())
+    val ops: StateFlow<List<PendingOp>> = _ops
+
+    fun init(filesDir: File) {
+        dir = File(filesDir, "sync").apply { mkdirs() }
+        _ops.value = runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(PendingOp.serializer()), queueFile.readText()) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
+    }
+
+    fun enqueue(path: String, body: Map<String, Any?>, label: String, photo: ByteArray? = null, photoKind: String? = null, signature: ByteArray? = null) {
+        val id = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+        val photoFile = photo?.let { File(dir, "$id.jpg").apply { writeBytes(it) }.name }
+        val sigFile = signature?.let { File(dir, "$id.sig.png").apply { writeBytes(it) }.name }
+        val op = PendingOp(id = id, path = path, body = body.toJson().toString(), label = label, photoFile = photoFile, photoKind = photoKind, signatureFile = sigFile)
+        scope.launch {
+            mutex.withLock { save(_ops.value + op) }
+            flush()
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun dismiss(op: PendingOp) {
+        scope.launch { mutex.withLock { remove(op) } }
+    }
+
+    fun clear() {
+        scope.launch { mutex.withLock { _ops.value.forEach(::remove) } }
+    }
+
+    /** Replays in capture order. Network/server errors stop the run; rule violations flag that item and move on. */
+    suspend fun flush() {
+        if (TokenStore.tokens == null || !mutex.tryLock()) return
+        try {
+            for (op in _ops.value.filter { !it.conflicted }) {
+                var current = op
+                try {
+                    val body = AppJson.parseToJsonElement(current.body).jsonObject.toMutableMap()
+                    current.photoFile?.let { name ->
+                        body["photo_key"] = JsonPrimitive(Api.upload(File(dir, name).readBytes(), current.photoKind ?: "door_photo"))
+                        File(dir, name).delete()
+                        current = current.copy(photoFile = null, body = JsonObject(body).toString()).also(::replace)
+                    }
+                    current.signatureFile?.let { name ->
+                        body["signature_key"] = JsonPrimitive(Api.upload(File(dir, name).readBytes(), "signature", "image/png"))
+                        File(dir, name).delete()
+                        current = current.copy(signatureFile = null, body = JsonObject(body).toString()).also(::replace)
+                    }
+                    Api.send("POST", current.path, body)
+                    remove(current)
+                } catch (e: ApiError) {
+                    if (e.status in 400..499 && e.status != 401 && e.status != 429) {
+                        replace(current.copy(conflicted = true, lastError = e.message))
+                    } else {
+                        replace(current.copy(attempts = current.attempts + 1, lastError = e.message))
+                        return
+                    }
+                } catch (e: Exception) {
+                    replace(current.copy(attempts = current.attempts + 1, lastError = e.message))
+                    return
+                }
+            }
+        } finally {
+            mutex.unlock()
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun flushInBackground() {
+        scope.launch { flush() }
+    }
+
+    private fun replace(op: PendingOp) = save(_ops.value.map { if (it.id == op.id) op else it })
+
+    private fun remove(op: PendingOp) {
+        listOfNotNull(op.photoFile, op.signatureFile).forEach { File(dir, it).delete() }
+        save(_ops.value.filterNot { it.id == op.id })
+    }
+
+    private fun save(list: List<PendingOp>) {
+        _ops.value = list
+        queueFile.writeText(AppJson.encodeToString(ListSerializer(PendingOp.serializer()), list))
+    }
+}

+/** Loads data with loading / error / retry states. `content` gets the value and a reload function. */
+@Composable
+fun <T> AsyncContent(key: Any? = Unit, load: suspend () -> T, content: @Composable (T, suspend () -> Unit) -> Unit) {
+    var value by remember(key) { mutableStateOf<T?>(null) }
+    var error by remember(key) { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
+    val reload: suspend () -> Unit = {
+        try {
+            value = load()
+            error = null
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            if (value == null) error = e.message ?: e.toString()
+        }
+    }
+    LaunchedEffect(key) { reload() }
+    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
+    val current = value
+    when {
+        current != null -> content(current, reload)
+        error != null -> Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center, horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
+            Icon(Icons.Filled.WifiOff, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp))
+            Text(stringResource(R.string.couldnt_load), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp))
+            Text(error.orEmpty(), textAlign = TextAlign.Center, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
+            Button(onClick = { scope.launch { reload() } }, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp)) { Text(stringResource(R.string.try_again)) }
+        }
+        else -> Loading()
+    }

+/** Finger signature, exported as PNG for the consent record. */
+@Composable
+fun SignaturePad(onChange: (ByteArray?) -> Unit) {
+    val lines = remember { mutableStateListOf<List<Offset>>() }
+    var current by remember { mutableStateOf<List<Offset>>(emptyList()) }
+    val ink = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
+    val label = stringResource(R.string.signature_area)
+
+    fun export(widthPx: Int, heightPx: Int) {
+        if (lines.isEmpty()) return onChange(null)
+        val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(widthPx, heightPx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
+        val c = AndroidCanvas(bmp).apply { drawColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE) }
+        val paint = Paint().apply { color = android.graphics.Color.BLACK; strokeWidth = 5f; style = Paint.Style.STROKE; isAntiAlias = true; strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND }
+        for (line in lines) for (i in 1 until line.size) c.drawLine(line[i - 1].x, line[i - 1].y, line[i].x, line[i].y, paint)
+        onChange(ByteArrayOutputStream().also { bmp.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, it) }.toByteArray())
+    }
+
+    Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp)) {
+        Canvas(
+            Modifier
+                .fillMaxWidth()
+                .height(140.dp)
+                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
+                .semantics { contentDescription = label }
+                .pointerInput(Unit) {
+                    detectDragGestures(
+                        onDragStart = { current = listOf(it) },
+                        onDrag = { change, _ -> current = current + change.position },
+                        onDragEnd = {
+                            lines.add(current)
+                            current = emptyList()
+                            export(this.size.width, this.size.height)
+                        },
+                    )
+                },
+        ) {
+            for (line in lines + listOf(current)) {
+                if (line.size < 2) continue
+                val path = Path().apply { moveTo(line[0].x, line[0].y); line.drop(1).forEach { lineTo(it.x, it.y) } }
+                drawPath(path, ink, style = Stroke(width = 5f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
+            }
+        }
+        TextButton(onClick = { lines.clear(); onChange(null) }, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.End)) { Text(stringResource(R.string.clear)) }
+    }
+}

+class ApiError(val status: Int, val code: String, serverMessage: String?, val conflictId: String?) :

+
+/** Request bodies are built as plain maps, like the iOS client. */
+fun Any?.toJson(): JsonElement = when (this) {
+    null -> JsonNull
+    is JsonElement -> this
+    is String -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Number -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Boolean -> JsonPrimitive(this)
+    is Map<*, *> -> JsonObject(entries.associate { (k, v) -> k.toString() to v.toJson() })

+
+/** Thin JSON client for the Worker API. Refreshes the access token once on 401. */
+object Api {
+    val base: String = BuildConfig.API_BASE_URL.trimEnd('/')

+        .connectTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
+        .readTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
+        .build()
+
+    private val jsonType = "application/json".toMediaType()
+    private val _sessionExpired = MutableSharedFlow<Unit>(extraBufferCapacity = 1)
+    val sessionExpired: SharedFlow<Unit> = _sessionExpired
+
+    suspend inline fun <reified T> get(path: String): T = AppJson.decodeFromString(data("GET", path))
+
+    suspend inline fun <reified T> post(path: String, body: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()): T =
+        AppJson.decodeFromString(data("POST", path, body))
+
+    suspend fun send(method: String, path: String, body: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()): String = data(method, path, body)
+
+    suspend fun data(method: String, path: String, body: Map<String, Any?>? = null, retried: Boolean = false): String =
+        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            val builder = Request.Builder().url("$base/v1/$path")
+            TokenStore.tokens?.let { builder.header("Authorization", "Bearer ${it.accessToken}") }
+            val payload = if (method == "GET") null else (body ?: emptyMap()).toJson().toString().toRequestBody(jsonType)
+            builder.method(method, payload)
+
+            val (status, text) = http.newCall(builder.build()).execute().use { it.code to it.body?.string().orEmpty() }
+
+            if (status == 401 && !retried && !path.startsWith("auth/")) {
+                val refresh = TokenStore.tokens?.refreshToken
+                if (refresh != null && refreshTokens(refresh)) return@withContext data(method, path, body, retried = true)
+                if (refresh != null) {
+                    TokenStore.tokens = null
+                    _sessionExpired.tryEmit(Unit)
+                }
+            }
+            if (status !in 200..299) {
+                val obj = runCatching { AppJson.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject }.getOrNull()
+                fun field(k: String) = obj?.get(k)?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
+                throw ApiError(status, field("error") ?: "http_$status", field("message"), field("conflict_id"))
+            }
+            text
+        }

+    private suspend fun refreshTokens(refresh: String): Boolean =
+        runCatching { post<Tokens>("auth/refresh", mapOf("refresh_token" to refresh)) }
+            .onSuccess { TokenStore.tokens = it }
+            .isSuccess
+
+    /** Two-step private upload: get a signed URL, then PUT the bytes. Returns the storage key. */
+    suspend fun upload(bytes: ByteArray, kind: String, contentType: String = "image/jpeg"): String {
+        val ticket = post<UploadTicket>("uploads", mapOf("kind" to kind, "content_type" to contentType))
+        val ok = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            val req = Request.Builder().url(ticket.uploadUrl).put(bytes.toRequestBody(contentType.toMediaType())).build()
+            http.newCall(req).execute().use { it.code == 201 }

+object OfflineCache {

+    suspend inline fun <reified T> get(path: String): T {
+        val file = File(dir, path.replace('/', '_') + ".json")
+        return try {
+            val text = Api.data("GET", path)
+            val value = AppJson.decodeFromString<T>(text)
+            runCatching { file.writeText(text) }
+            value
+        } catch (e: IOException) {
+            val cached = runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString<T>(file.readText()) }.getOrNull()

+/** Access + refresh tokens, encrypted with a key that never leaves the Android Keystore. */
+object TokenStore {
+    private const val ALIAS = "dealerdoor.tokens"
+    private lateinit var prefs: SharedPreferences
+    private var cached: Tokens? = null
+    private var loaded = false
+
+    fun init(context: Context) {
+        prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("secure", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+    }
+
+    var tokens: Tokens?
+        @Synchronized get() {
+            if (!loaded) {
+                cached = prefs.getString("tokens", null)?.let { runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString<Tokens>(decrypt(it)) }.getOrNull() }
+                loaded = true
+            }
+            return cached
+        }
+        @Synchronized set(value) {
+            cached = value
+            loaded = true
+            prefs.edit().apply {
+                if (value == null) remove("tokens") else putString("tokens", encrypt(AppJson.encodeToString(Tokens.serializer(), value)))
+            }.apply()
+        }

+                .setEncryptionPaddings(KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE)

+    }
+
+    private fun encrypt(plain: String): String {
+        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding").apply { init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key()) }
+        return Base64.encodeToString(cipher.iv + cipher.doFinal(plain.toByteArray()), Base64.NO_WRAP)
+    }
+
+    private fun decrypt(stored: String): String {
+        val bytes = Base64.decode(stored, Base64.NO_WRAP)
+        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding").apply { init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, key(), GCMParameterSpec(128, bytes, 0, 12)) }
+        return String(cipher.doFinal(bytes, 12, bytes.size - 12))
+    }
+}

+}

+// ---- Auth ----
+
+sealed interface AuthState {
+    data object Loading : AuthState
+    data object SignedOut : AuthState
+    data object Locked : AuthState
+    data class SignedIn(val me: Me) : AuthState
+}
+
+object Auth {
+    private val _state = MutableStateFlow<AuthState>(AuthState.Loading)
+    val state: StateFlow<AuthState> = _state
+    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main)
+
+    fun init() {
+        // Returning users unlock with fingerprint / face / screen lock instead of a new magic link.
+        _state.value = if (TokenStore.tokens == null) AuthState.SignedOut else AuthState.Locked
+        scope.launch { Api.sessionExpired.collect { _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut } }
+    }
+
+    fun resetForUiTest() {
+        TokenStore.tokens = null
+        OfflineCache.clear()
+        SyncEngine.clear()
+        _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut
+    }
+
+    /** Password login returns tokens; otherwise the server emails a link (debug builds get the token back). */
+    suspend fun login(email: String, password: String?): Boolean {
+        val body = buildMap<String, Any?> {
+            put("email", email)
+            if (!password.isNullOrEmpty()) put("password", password)
+        }
+        val res = Api.post<LoginResponse>("auth/login", body)
+        if (res.accessToken != null && res.refreshToken != null) return finish(Tokens(res.accessToken, res.refreshToken))
+        if (com.dealerdoor.app.BuildConfig.DEBUG && res.devToken != null) return verify(res.devToken)
+        return false
+    }
+
+    suspend fun verify(token: String): Boolean = finish(Api.post("auth/verify", mapOf("token" to token)))
+
+    /** Handles dealerdoor://auth?token=… from the sign-in email. */
+    fun handle(uri: Uri) {
+        val token = uri.getQueryParameter("token") ?: return
+        scope.launch { runCatching { verify(token) } }
+    }
+
+    private suspend fun finish(tokens: Tokens): Boolean {
+        TokenStore.tokens = tokens
+        loadMe()
+        return true
+    }
+
+    suspend fun loadMe() {
+        val me = Api.get<Me>("me")
+        _state.value = AuthState.SignedIn(me)
+        // Keep server-side email language in sync with the phone.
+        if (me.locale != Lang.code) runCatching { Api.send("PATCH", "me", mapOf("locale" to Lang.code)) }
+    }
+
+    fun unlocked() {
+        scope.launch { runCatching { loadMe() }.onFailure { _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut } }
+    }
+
+    fun signOut() {
+        scope.launch {
+            TokenStore.tokens?.refreshToken?.let { refresh -> runCatching { Api.send("POST", "auth/logout", mapOf("refresh_token" to refresh)) } }
+            TokenStore.tokens = null
+            OfflineCache.clear()
+            _state.value = AuthState.SignedOut
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+// ---- Connectivity & location ----
+
+object NetworkMonitor {
+    private val _online = MutableStateFlow(true)
+    val online: StateFlow<Boolean> = _online
+
+    fun start(context: Context) {
+        val cm = context.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)
+        _online.value = cm.activeNetwork != null
+        cm.registerDefaultNetworkCallback(object : ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
+            override fun onAvailable(network: Network) {
+                val cameBack = !_online.value
+                _online.value = true
+                if (cameBack) SyncEngine.flushInBackground()
+            }
+
+            override fun onLost(network: Network) {
+                _online.value = false
+            }
+        })
+    }
+}
+
+object LocationTracker {
+    private val _location = MutableStateFlow<Location?>(null)
+    val location: StateFlow<Location?> = _location
+    private var started = false
+
+    fun hasPermission(context: Context) =
+        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
+
+    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
+    fun start(context: Context) {
+        if (started || !hasPermission(context)) return
+        started = true
+        val lm = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
+        val listener = LocationListener { _location.value = it }
+        for (provider in listOf(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)) {
+            if (lm.isProviderEnabled(provider)) {
+                lm.getLastKnownLocation(provider)?.let { if (_location.value == null) _location.value = it }
+                lm.requestLocationUpdates(provider, 5_000L, 5f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper())
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** Street address for the rep's current spot (on-device geocoder, no API key). */
+    suspend fun currentAddress(context: Context): String? {
+        val loc = _location.value ?: return null
+        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
+            val a = runCatching { Geocoder(context, Locale.US).getFromLocation(loc.latitude, loc.longitude, 1)?.firstOrNull() }.getOrNull()
+                ?: return@withContext null
+            listOfNotNull(
+                listOfNotNull(a.subThoroughfare, a.thoroughfare).joinToString(" ").ifBlank { null },
+                a.locality,
+                listOfNotNull(a.adminArea?.let(::stateCode), a.postalCode).joinToString(" ").ifBlank { null },
+            ).joinToString(", ")
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun stateCode(name: String) = if (name.equals("Washington", ignoreCase = true)) "WA" else name
+}
+
+// ---- Formatting & images ----
+
+object Fmt {
+    fun money(cents: Int): String = NumberFormat.getCurrencyInstance(Locale.US).format(cents / 100.0)
+
+    private fun parse(s: String): Instant? =
+        runCatching { OffsetDateTime.parse(s).toInstant() }.getOrNull()
+            ?: runCatching { LocalDateTime.parse(s.replace(' ', 'T')).toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC) }.getOrNull()
+
+    /** Accepts ISO-8601 and SQLite "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (UTC). */
+    fun date(s: String?, time: Boolean = false): String {
+        if (s == null) return "—"
+        val instant = parse(s) ?: return s
+        val f = if (time) DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDateTime(FormatStyle.MEDIUM, FormatStyle.SHORT) else DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM)
+        return f.withLocale(Locale.getDefault()).format(instant.atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()))
+    }
+
+    /** Due dates are plain YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific time. */
+    fun day(s: String): String =
+        runCatching { DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM).withLocale(Locale.getDefault()).format(LocalDate.parse(s)) }.getOrDefault(s)
+
+    fun iso(instant: Instant): String = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_INSTANT.format(instant)
+}
+
+object ImageTools {
+    /** Downscale to keep uploads small on LTE. */
+    fun jpeg(context: Context, uri: Uri, maxSide: Int = 1600): ByteArray? = runCatching {
+        val bitmap = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use(BitmapFactory::decodeStream) ?: return null
+        val scale = minOf(1f, maxSide.toFloat() / maxOf(bitmap.width, bitmap.height))
+        val scaled = if (scale < 1f) Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bitmap, (bitmap.width * scale).toInt(), (bitmap.height * scale).toInt(), true) else bitmap
+        ByteArrayOutputStream().also { scaled.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 70, it) }.toByteArray()
+    }.getOrNull()
+}

+package com.dealerdoor.app.core

+import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope

+import java.util.UUID
+
+/** A field capture (lead, check-in, appointment) waiting to reach the server. Photos live next to the queue file. */
+@Serializable
+data class PendingOp(
+    val id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
+    val path: String,
+    val body: String,
+    val label: String,
+    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
+    val attempts: Int = 0,
+    val lastError: String? = null,
+    /** Server refused it on a business rule (e.g. do-not-knock); kept for the rep to see, never retried. */
+    val conflicted: Boolean = false,
+    val photoFile: String? = null,
+    val photoKind: String? = null,
+    val signatureFile: String? = null,
+)
+
+/**
+ * Every capture goes through this queue, online or not, so there is one code path.
+ * Records carry a client UUID in `body["id"]`, so the API treats replays as no-ops.
+ */
+object SyncEngine {
+    private lateinit var dir: File
+    private val queueFile get() = File(dir, "queue.json")
+    private val mutex = Mutex()
+    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
+    private val _ops = MutableStateFlow<List<PendingOp>>(emptyList())
+    val ops: StateFlow<List<PendingOp>> = _ops
+
+    fun init(filesDir: File) {
+        dir = File(filesDir, "sync").apply { mkdirs() }
+        _ops.value = runCatching { AppJson.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(PendingOp.serializer()), queueFile.readText()) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
+    }
+
+    fun enqueue(path: String, body: Map<String, Any?>, label: String, photo: ByteArray? = null, photoKind: String? = null, signature: ByteArray? = null) {
+        val id = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+        val photoFile = photo?.let { File(dir, "$id.jpg").apply { writeBytes(it) }.name }
+        val sigFile = signature?.let { File(dir, "$id.sig.png").apply { writeBytes(it) }.name }
+        val op = PendingOp(id = id, path = path, body = body.toJson().toString(), label = label, photoFile = photoFile, photoKind = photoKind, signatureFile = sigFile)
+        scope.launch {
+            mutex.withLock { save(_ops.value + op) }
+            flush()
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun dismiss(op: PendingOp) {
+        scope.launch { mutex.withLock { remove(op) } }
+    }
+
+    fun clear() {
+        scope.launch { mutex.withLock { _ops.value.forEach(::remove) } }
+    }
+
+    /** Replays in capture order. Network/server errors stop the run; rule violations flag that item and move on. */
+    suspend fun flush() {
+        if (TokenStore.tokens == null || !mutex.tryLock()) return
+        try {
+            for (op in _ops.value.filter { !it.conflicted }) {
+                var current = op
+                try {
+                    val body = AppJson.parseToJsonElement(current.body).jsonObject.toMutableMap()
+                    current.photoFile?.let { name ->
+                        body["photo_key"] = JsonPrimitive(Api.upload(File(dir, name).readBytes(), current.photoKind ?: "door_photo"))
+                        File(dir, name).delete()
+                        current = current.copy(photoFile = null, body = JsonObject(body).toString()).also(::replace)
+                    }
+                    current.signatureFile?.let { name ->
+                        body["signature_key"] = JsonPrimitive(Api.upload(File(dir, name).readBytes(), "signature", "image/png"))
+                        File(dir, name).delete()
+                        current = current.copy(signatureFile = null, body = JsonObject(body).toString()).also(::replace)
+                    }
+                    Api.send("POST", current.path, body)
+                    remove(current)
+                } catch (e: ApiError) {
+                    if (e.status in 400..499 && e.status != 401 && e.status != 429) {
+                        replace(current.copy(conflicted = true, lastError = e.message))
+                    } else {
+                        replace(current.copy(attempts = current.attempts + 1, lastError = e.message))
+                        return
+                    }
+                } catch (e: Exception) {
+                    replace(current.copy(attempts = current.attempts + 1, lastError = e.message))
+                    return
+                }
+            }
+        } finally {
+            mutex.unlock()
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun flushInBackground() {
+        scope.launch { flush() }
+    }
+
+    private fun replace(op: PendingOp) = save(_ops.value.map { if (it.id == op.id) op else it })
+
+    private fun remove(op: PendingOp) {
+        listOfNotNull(op.photoFile, op.signatureFile).forEach { File(dir, it).delete() }
+        save(_ops.value.filterNot { it.id == op.id })
+    }
+
+    private fun save(list: List<PendingOp>) {
+        _ops.value = list
+        queueFile.writeText(AppJson.encodeToString(ListSerializer(PendingOp.serializer()), list))
+    }
+}

+/** Loads data with loading / error / retry states. `content` gets the value and a reload function. */
+@Composable
+fun <T> AsyncContent(key: Any? = Unit, load: suspend () -> T, content: @Composable (T, suspend () -> Unit) -> Unit) {
+    var value by remember(key) { mutableStateOf<T?>(null) }
+    var error by remember(key) { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
+    val reload: suspend () -> Unit = {
+        try {
+            value = load()
+            error = null
+        } catch (e: Exception) {
+            if (value == null) error = e.message ?: e.toString()
+        }
+    }
+    LaunchedEffect(key) { reload() }
+    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
+    val current = value
+    when {
+        current != null -> content(current, reload)
+        error != null -> Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center, horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
+            Icon(Icons.Filled.WifiOff, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp))
+            Text(stringResource(R.string.couldnt_load), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp))
+            Text(error.orEmpty(), textAlign = TextAlign.Center, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
+            Button(onClick = { scope.launch { reload() } }, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp)) { Text(stringResource(R.string.try_again)) }
+        }
+        else -> Loading()
+    }

+/** Finger signature, exported as PNG for the consent record. */
+@Composable
+fun SignaturePad(onChange: (ByteArray?) -> Unit) {
+    val lines = remember { mutableStateListOf<List<Offset>>() }
+    var current by remember { mutableStateOf<List<Offset>>(emptyList()) }
+    val ink = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
+    val label = stringResource(R.string.signature_area)
+
+    fun export(widthPx: Int, heightPx: Int) {
+        if (lines.isEmpty()) return onChange(null)
+        val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(widthPx, heightPx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
+        val c = AndroidCanvas(bmp).apply { drawColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE) }
+        val paint = Paint().apply { color = android.graphics.Color.BLACK; strokeWidth = 5f; style = Paint.Style.STROKE; isAntiAlias = true; strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND }
+        for (line in lines) for (i in 1 until line.size) c.drawLine(line[i - 1].x, line[i - 1].y, line[i].x, line[i].y, paint)
+        onChange(ByteArrayOutputStream().also { bmp.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, it) }.toByteArray())
+    }
+
+    Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp)) {
+        Canvas(
+            Modifier
+                .fillMaxWidth()
+                .height(140.dp)
+                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
+                .semantics { contentDescription = label }
+                .pointerInput(Unit) {
+                    detectDragGestures(
+                        onDragStart = { current = listOf(it) },
+                        onDrag = { change, _ -> current = current + change.position },
+                        onDragEnd = {
+                            lines.add(current)
+                            current = emptyList()
+                            export(this.size.width, this.size.height)
+                        },
+                    )
+                },
+        ) {
+            for (line in lines + listOf(current)) {
+                if (line.size < 2) continue
+                val path = Path().apply { moveTo(line[0].x, line[0].y); line.drop(1).forEach { lineTo(it.x, it.y) } }
+                drawPath(path, ink, style = Stroke(width = 5f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
+            }
+        }
+        TextButton(onClick = { lines.clear(); onChange(null) }, modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.End)) { Text(stringResource(R.string.clear)) }
+    }
+}
